waves.name: Proof authority
waves.goal: Make every later green verdict trustworthy and candidate-bound.
conditions: The installed smoke can pass only after attaching to a packaged Tauri desktop surface, never a browser fallback.
The installed receipt derives its source identity from the running build and records a SHA-256 for the tested artifact; it never stamps ambient repository HEAD as the tested build.
The READY gate rejects browser-mode, dirty, artifact-unbound, stale, or source-mismatched installed receipts.
The product-perfect controller rejects missing, stale, hand-asserted, or definition-mismatched receipts.

waves.name: Security and trust boundaries
waves.goal: Close every verified security and privacy escape at the boundary where it originates.
conditions: Agent child processes receive an explicit allowlisted environment and no ambient StarNet, provider, channel, or connector secret.
The bundled Node runtime is a currently supported patched build and is proven by the packaged artifact.
Browser navigation resolves DNS and blocks private, loopback, link-local, metadata, and rebinding targets across redirects.
Filesystem search cannot follow a symlink or junction outside an authorized root.
Channel ownership requires explicit pairing and consent; a first inbound message cannot claim control.
Runnable Workshop content never receives a reusable global API token.
Default UI boot makes no unconsented third-party request, and persisted connector/channel secrets are protected and redacted.

waves.name: Truthful product authority
waves.goal: Ensure every product status and capability claim comes from authoritative backend state.
conditions: Capability labels such as fullOffice reflect effective grants, not execution mode or account presence.
Uplink health follows transport heartbeat/connection authority and remains live during a healthy idle stream.
App-close, tray, channel, and background-operation copy matches the process lifecycle on every supported platform.
Global status, run state, counts, and health indicators are derived from the owning backend and contain no decorative success state.

waves.name: Last-mile UI and recovery
waves.goal: Remove stranded interactions and prove the complete recovery path for user-owned work.
conditions: Export, backup, restore, OPEN, undo, and destructive-action recovery complete end to end with truthful feedback.
Base-URL configuration and OAuth start, success, cancellation, denial, timeout, and retry paths are usable and recoverable.
Every user-facing failure has a specific next action and no control ends in a silent or permanent busy state.
The attended visual pass finds no clipped, overlapping, inaccessible, placeholder, or inconsistent release-facing UI.

waves.name: Autonomy vision
waves.goal: Prove that the differentiating autonomy promises are coherent, controllable, and measurably real.
conditions: Signal synchronization has an observable source, conflict policy, recovery path, and live round-trip proof.
Commander composition provides one coherent context/control surface without hidden split authority.
Learning claims are backed by persisted, inspectable behavior changes and user controls; otherwise the claim is removed or relabeled.
Autonomous work remains interruptible, budget-bounded, permission-gated, and recoverable after restart.

waves.name: External integration reality
waves.goal: Make every advertised external integration demonstrably usable or honestly limited.
conditions: Each advertised provider, connector, channel, OAuth flow, and remote service has an attended real-credential success receipt and a failure/revocation receipt.
Unavailable, partial, or untested integrations are visibly labeled experimental or unsupported at the point of use.
No real credential is written to evidence, source, logs, scheduled-task definitions, URLs, or child-process environments.

waves.name: Full UI and backend behavioral proof
waves.goal: Prove every created UI surface and backend promise against the running product.
conditions: The Station Atlas is fresh on the candidate and reports perfected-fresh equal to total, with zero unmapped, mapped-only, audited-only, stale, or missing entries.
Backend-only tools, persistence boundaries, desktop commands, integrations, and lifecycle promises not represented by the Atlas have explicit machine/live proof.
Fast, HTTP/E2E, journey, recovery, restart, long-lived, visual, and installed-desktop suites all pass on the same candidate.
The product-facing ledger has zero open P0, P1, or P2 findings; accepted limitations are explicit non-product release exclusions, not hidden debt.

waves.name: Frozen product-validation candidate
waves.goal: Validate one immutable desktop candidate long enough to justify the PRODUCT PERFECT verdict.
conditions: Every receipt names the same clean source commit, app version, packaged artifact SHA-256 values, and wave-definition hash.
The frozen candidate completes at least 48 continuous hours of representative real-provider dogfood with no P0/P1, truth escape, data-loss event, wedged run, or unexplained sidecar death.
READY, installed desktop, full Atlas, security, recovery, integration, and behavioral gates are rerun after the soak without rebuilding the artifact.
The terminal output is PRODUCT PERFECT; it does not authorize publishing, signing, deployment, credential rotation, or public release.
